## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与最终行为

Describe the concrete trigger and the final change. Link an existing issue if applicable.
说明具体触发条件、修改后的行为；有相关 issue 时关联。

## Validation / 验证

Commands actually run, results, and anything not verified. For UI changes, add non-sensitive screenshots; for packaging/path changes, describe installed-wheel execution outside the source tree.
填写真实运行命令、结果和未测范围；不要粘贴旧版本通过数量。

## Scope and limitations / 范围与限制

Mention compatibility, data exposure, changed defaults, or known failure cases where relevant.
如有配置、数据传输、默认行为或兼容性变化，请明确说明。

## Checklist / 清单

- [ ] The diff is focused; unrelated formatting and refactors are excluded. / 改动聚焦，无无关重构。
- [ ] Relevant checks are listed above; unverified items are stated. / 已列实际检查与未测项。
- [ ] No credentials, private documents, databases, weights or machine-specific artifacts are included. / 无凭据或私密运行材料。
- [ ] Documentation and Chinese/English instructions match changed behavior where applicable. / 相关中英文说明已同步。
- [ ] Fixed evaluation cases were not changed to improve scores; limitations are reported. / 未改固定题刷分。
- [ ] AI assistance and third-party sources/licenses are disclosed where applicable. / 如实说明 AI 辅助和第三方来源。
